facts.business: Saatvik Green Energy Limited manufactures solar cells, modules, ingots, wafers, and encapsulants, and provides EPC services, inverters, transformers, solar pumps, and turnkey solutions across the solar energy value chain.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Phase I (2.4 GW) under implementation, ALMM-II inspection planned September 2026; total roadmap 6 GW
Phase I 4 GW under implementation; target 8.8 GW cumulative
2 GW commissioned during FY2025-26, planned enhancement to 5 GW (Ambala & Odisha)
Civil and structural works substantially completed during FY2025-26; expected to increase modules capacity from 4.8 GW to 8.8 GW

guidance_or_targets.statement: Scale manufacturing to 6 GW solar cells, 8.8 GW modules, 6 GW ingots and wafers, and 5 GW encapsulant capacity
guidance_or_targets.value: 6 GW cells, 8.8 GW modules, 6 GW ingots/wafers, 5 GW encapsulant

guidance_or_targets.statement: ALMM-II inspection for Phase I solar cells (2.4 GW) and modules (4 GW)

key_risks: Forward-looking statements subject to assumptions, risks and uncertainties; actual results may differ materially
Revenue recognition involves significant judgment due to distinct commercial terms and Incoterms across customer contracts
Dependence on government-led opportunities like CPSU Scheme mandating domestic content requirements
Supply chain resilience and backward integration execution risks
Inventory write-downs to net realisable value (INR 20.54 million in FY2026)
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables from related parties: INR 49.80 million (March 31, 2026) vs INR 171.82 million (March 31, 2025); shares of other party (51% stake) pledged in favor of Saatvik Cleantech EPC; business combinations under common control accounted using pooling of interest method
